key_points: CEO William Brown states operational turnaround is ahead of schedule with expanding new product activity, improved delivery, and rising margins.
Data-center opportunity tied to Microsoft partnership adds a credible growth narrative.
Higher 2026 targets suggest management confidence in forward earnings power.
PFAS litigation continues to resurface, capping upside and maintaining a valuation overhang.
Multiple independent outlets corroborate the faster-than-expected turnaround, lending credibility to the narrative.
